characteristic_features: constitutional symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss)

biomarkers.name: JAK2 V617F
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic; supports JAK-STAT pathway activation and JAK inhibitor rationale

biomarkers.name: CALR mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic; type 1/type 1-like CALR is associated with more favourable prognosis than JAK2/MPL or triple-negative disease

biomarkers.name: ASXL1, SRSF2, EZH2, IDH1/2, U2AF1 Q157 (HMR mutations)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Adverse; MIPSS70/MIPSS70+ v2 and related models incorporate these for risk stratification and transplant decision-making

biomarkers.name: DIPSS / DIPSS-plus / MIPSS70+ v2 / MYSEC-PM / MTSS
biomarkers.clinical_use: Guide prognosis and transplant referral. MYSEC-PM: for secondary myelofibrosis (post-PV/ET)

biomarkers.name: JAK inhibitor response (ruxolitinib, fedratinib, momelotinib, pacritinib)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Ruxolitinib: standard for symptoms and splenomegaly. Momelotinib: useful in anaemic patients (also ACVR1/hepcidin-related activity). Pacritinib: option in severe thrombocytopenia, including platelet count <50 x10^9/L. Fedratinib: approved option after or including ruxolitinib exposure depending on setting.

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Marrow reticulin/collagen fibrosis with atypical megakaryocyte clustering and osteosclerosis in advanced stages
variants: prefibrotic PMF (early phase, mild reticulin, often mistaken for ET)
post-PV or post-ET myelofibrosis (secondary — MYSEC-PM score)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Fibrosis grade 0-3 (MF-0 to MF-3); DIPSS/MIPSS70+ prognostic scores

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Elevated inflammatory cytokines (including IL-6, TNF-α, IL-8) drive constitutional symptoms and cachexia; JAK-STAT signalling is pathogenic
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Marrow fibrosis with atypical megakaryocyte clusters is defining; extramedullary haematopoiesis in massive splenomegaly (and liver) as marrow fails; leukoerythroblastic blood picture

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: HSC with JAK-STAT-activating driver mutations driving progressive marrow fibrosis through inflammatory cytokine production and megakaryocyte dysregulation
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Progressive marrow fibrosis with atypical megakaryocyte clustering; extramedullary haematopoiesis in massive splenomegaly (and liver) as marrow fails; leukoerythroblastic blood picture
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Same major driver mutations as PV/ET (JAK2, CALR, MPL) but with additional high molecular risk mutations (ASXL1, EZH2, IDH1/2, SRSF2, U2AF1 Q157) associated with more aggressive biology; extramedullary haematopoiesis represents adaptive redeployment of haematopoiesis to fetal-like sites (spleen, liver)
